generic_name: Dextrose, Soybean Oil, Electrolytes, and Amino Acids (Complete Parenteral Nutrition Formula)
purpose: This is a complete liquid nutrition formula given directly into your vein when you cannot eat or drink enough on your own. It provides your body with sugar for energy, healthy fats, proteins (in the form of amino acids), and essential minerals. Doctors use it when your digestive system cannot absorb nutrients normally, such as after major surgery, serious illness, or certain bowel conditions.
how_it_works: Think of it as a full meal delivered straight into your bloodstream. The dextrose (a type of sugar) gives your body energy, the soybean oil provides healthy fats, and the amino acids are the building blocks your body uses to repair tissues and make proteins. The electrolytes — like sodium, potassium, and magnesium — help keep your body's fluid balance, nerve function, and muscles working properly.
common_side_effects: Some people may experience nausea, high or low blood sugar, fever, or fluid buildup (swelling). You might also notice redness, swelling, or discomfort at the IV site. Abnormal levels of fats or minerals in your blood can also occur, which is why your care team will monitor you closely.
warnings: This must only be given under close medical supervision in a hospital or clinical setting. It is not safe if you have certain conditions like severe liver disease, very high blood fat levels, or serious metabolic disorders. Blood sugar, kidney function, and electrolyte levels need to be checked regularly during treatment. Tell your doctor about all medications you take, as some can interact with this formula. Infections at the IV site are possible, so strict hygiene is essential.
typical_dosing: The dose is completely personalized — your doctor and nutrition team will calculate exactly how much you need based on your weight, health condition, and nutritional needs. It is given as a slow, continuous drip through an IV, usually over many hours each day. Your care team will adjust the amount regularly based on blood test results and how your body is responding.
